name: Lily of the Valley: Unofficial Ren'Py Port
source:
The story revolves around two young people, Lily and Nick, who, recently got married. Led by immense love, they decide to start their life together living temporarily in Fred's (Nick's father's) house. Their plan seems simple at first sight. All the money they would spend on the rent, they will save up for the dream they've had since the moment they met, and that is to buy their own place.
But, just as in real life, things are not as perfect as we plan them. 

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/pandp]Patreon[/url]]

An unofficial fan-made Ren'Py port of the original RPG Maker game "Lily of the Valley". The original game is not a visual novel.
translation:
故事围绕着两个刚刚结婚的年轻人莉莉和尼克展开。在巨大的爱的引领下，他们决定暂时住在弗雷德（尼克父亲）的房子里开始共同生活。他们的计划乍一看似乎很简单。他们花在房租上的所有钱，都会为他们从相遇那一刻起就有的梦想攒起来，那就是买一套属于自己的房子。
但是，就像在现实生活中一样，事情并不像我们计划的那么完美。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/pandp]Patreon[/url]]

原创RPG Maker游戏“铃兰”的非官方粉丝制作的Ren'Py移植版。原版游戏不是视觉小说。
